plugin.name: Law Firm Management
plugin.description: Case intake & approval, regulatory-grade conflict-of-interest checks with collaborative clearance, billing & invoice ledger (manual reconciliation and Kingdee/Yonyou integration), and lawyer workload & executive dashboard.
expense.formHint: Court fees, expert fees, travel and similar costs are not legal fees. The client pays them separately, so they are kept apart from the legal fees under Invoicing & Fee Collection. Under China's Measures for the Administration of Lawyers' Service Fees, settlement must include a list of costs paid on the client's behalf with valid vouchers; the client may refuse any part without a valid voucher. This ledger is stored on this device.
expense.matterPlaceholder: e.g. Lanhai Optoelectronics v. Huaxing Semiconductor
expense.voucherPlaceholder: e.g. Court receipt No.0012345; leave blank if none
expense.needAmount: Enter an amount greater than 0 with at most two decimals.
expense.quota: Local plugin storage is full (64 KB). Delete older settled entries first.
Law firm overview (read-only): intake/matter status, KPIs and pending conflict clearances; optional project or keyword filter. Use when the user asks about the firm's intake, matters, conflict-clearance progress or monthly business overview.
tool.lawfirm_management_conflict_check.d: Conflict-of-interest check (read-only, nothing is saved): compares a client and counterparty against existing matters. Use when the user asks whether a client or counterparty has a conflict of interest.
tool.lawfirm_management_fee_ledger.desc: Read the fee ledger (read-only): invoices, collections, receivables and collection rate; filter by project or keyword. Law firm administrators only. Use when the user asks about firm-wide fees, collections, bills, invoices or receivables.
access.restricted: You don't have permission to view firm-wide data. Only items related to you are shown. The firm-wide fee ledger and dashboards are limited to law firm administrators.
access.queue.emptyLocal: The local conflict review queue is empty.
access.kpi.activeSubLocal: Only intakes in the local ledger that involve you
access.kpi.activeSubDevice: Live summary of this device's ledger
access.kpi.contractedDevice: Total contracted amount on this device
billing.title: Hourly billing: from time review to the bill
billing.intro: Lawyers build time from their work log, or add it manually, under Settings › Work log › Billable time and submit it. The lead lawyer or a partner reviews it here each month and issues bills. Once the client confirms, the bill amount becomes an invoice application under Invoicing & Fees, where invoicing and collections are handled as usual. Rates are tax-inclusive; amounts round to the cent. This ledger is stored on this computer.
billing.seeded: Sample loaded: an hourly matter for the fictional client Xinghe Tech, {n} submitted entries from last month by four lawyers of different levels, a rate card, and a 10% discount with a fee cap.
billing.reviewHint: Grouped by client and matter. Write-downs, description edits, no-charge and returns are all kept in the review trail, and lawyers see the outcome and reason in their work log.
billing.noMatterHint: These entries belong to projects not yet registered under Intake, so they cannot be billed. Register the matter and link the project, then approve.
billing.groupSummary: {n} entries, {pending} to review; {h} billable hours, {amount} at the applicable rates
billing.approveAll: Approve all {n} pending entries for this matter
billing.reasonPlaceholder: Required for write-downs, no charge and returns
billing.audit.WRITE_DOWN_EDIT: wrote down and edited the description
billing.newBillHint: Collects this matter's approved, billable, unbilled entries in the selected month. The discount applies first, then the matter's cumulative fee cap.
billing.pendingWarn: {n} entries for this matter are still awaiting review this month and are not on this bill.
billing.noChargeInfo: {n} more entries are marked no charge and are not billed.
billing.capRemaining: Remaining under the matter's fee cap before this bill: {left}.
billing.created: Bill {no} created. Check it, then use Send to client.
billing.standardValue: At standard rates and recorded hours
billing.col.standardRate: Firm standard hourly rate (CNY, tax incl.)
billing.sent: Bill marked as awaiting client confirmation. Record the confirmation below its details.
billing.sentHint: When the client confirms, enter who confirmed and the invoice details. An invoice application awaiting issue is then created under Invoicing & Fees.
billing.cancelled: Bill cancelled. Its entries are back to Approved and can be billed again.
billing.taxIdPlaceholder: Blank uses the credit code from intake
billing.confirmedWithInvoice: Client confirmation recorded and invoice application {no} created. Issue the invoice and record payments under Invoicing & Fees.
billing.confirmedNoInvoice: Client confirmation recorded. The amount due is 0 (fee cap used up), so no invoice application was created.
billing.timekeepersHint: The rate is fixed on each entry when it is approved; later rate changes do not affect approved entries or issued bills.
billing.termsHint: Per the engagement letter: agreed rates by level override the firm standard rate (blank uses the standard rate); the discount is a percentage; the cap is the cumulative limit across all bills for the matter.
billing.metrics: Billable hours and realization by lawyer
billing.metricsHint: Counts entries by work date in the selected month. Realization = collected ÷ value at standard rates, counting only entries with an outcome: on a client-confirmed bill, or marked no charge at review. Collected is the payments reconciled against that bill's invoice under Invoicing & Fees, split across lawyers in proportion to their line amounts.
billing.failed: The action did not complete. Please try again later.
billing.recalculated: These bills already sent to the client were recalculated because fee-cap room was freed; send them again: {nos}
